Action: Unpack and take out the control cabinet.
Transport the control cabinet to the intended mounting location.
Connect the robot and control cabinet.
Connect the cabinet to protective earth.
If control cabinets in use are certain models of CAB LiteDC, it must be connected to an isolated power supply.
Connect the control cabinet power cable to the power supply socket.
Connect the control cabinet and control stick, if an optional teach pendant is configured, connect the control cabinet to the teach pendant.
Connect the robot by control stick or teach pendant.
Power on and enable the robot by control stick.
